original_problem: N+1 query execution during relational list fetching caused severe latency spikes (> 1500ms).
verified_root_cause: Child relationship entities were lazily evaluated in a loop instead of performing eager JOIN fetching.
solution: Refactored repository query to use eager joined loading (joinedload / select_related) in a single round-trip.

regression_prevention_strategy.description: Added test asserting total SQL query count is exactly 1 when fetching collection of 100 entities.

supporting_evidence.verification_output_summary: Passed. Query count verified <= 1. Latency reduced from 1540ms to 42ms.
